name: image_transfer
description: Pull image from azure image registry and push it to quay image registry
author: Aravinthan Selvaraj

arguments.name: release
arguments.description: Release ZIP archive; it is extracted beside the archive.

arguments.name: release_scripts_directory
arguments.description: Directory inside the extracted release that holds the deployment scripts.

arguments.name: transfer_script
arguments.description: Name of the image transfer script in the scripts directory.

arguments.name: apply_script
arguments.description: Name of the OpenShift apply script in the scripts directory.

arguments.name: release_base_path
arguments.description: Base path replaced by the extracted release path in the apply script's 'oc apply -f' commands.

arguments.name: min_free_storage_gb
arguments.description: Minimum free Docker storage in GB (must be greater than zero).

arguments.name: old_image_pattern
arguments.description: Regular expression matching old Docker images that may be removed to free storage.

arguments.name: cleanup_builder_cache
arguments.description: Prune the Docker builder cache before transferring images.

arguments.name: skip_docker
arguments.description: Skip the Docker storage checks and the image transfer.

arguments.name: validate_yaml
arguments.description: Check that the YAML files referenced by the apply script exist.

arguments.name: force_remove_processed
arguments.description: Remove an existing extracted release directory before extracting.

outputs.name: force_remove_processed
outputs.description: Whether an existing extracted release could be removed.

outputs.name: docker_storage
outputs.description: Docker storage check: docker_root, free_bytes, free_gb, minimum_required_gb.

outputs.name: cleanup_performed
outputs.description: Whether old Docker images were removed.

outputs.name: docker_skipped
outputs.description: Whether Docker checks and the image transfer were skipped.

outputs.name: yaml_script_prepared
outputs.description: Whether the apply script was prepared.

outputs.name: yaml_paths
outputs.description: YAML paths referenced by the prepared apply script.

outputs.name: release_path
outputs.description: Directory the release was extracted to.
